subject: Falcon Health — budget commitment window and PO path
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@falconhealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Falcon Health follow-up — monthly spend band & procurement path

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can align with your procurement team: 

1) Volume profile you gave: 25M–100M tokens/month for the initial pilot expanding to production over 2–3 quarters.
2) Budget guidance you said you were comfortable with: a monthly spend band in the ballpark of $7.5k–$30k (see math below).
3) Procurement threshold: internal PO approvals kick in at $25k, and anything above requires vendor onboarding + net-30 terms.

Pricing math we used on the call (two simple scenarios):
- Pay-as-you-go baseline: target $/1M tokens = $300.
  • 25M tokens -> 25 * $300 = $7,500 / month
  • 100M tokens -> 100 * $300 = $30,000 / month
- Committed path (12-month commit / reserved capacity): we can discuss stepped discounts that would move the effective $/1M closer to $220–$260 depending on firm volume and prepay.

Attachments: I attached a quick token estimate sheet and our 2027 pricing card for your finance/procurement review.

Next asks / proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm whether Procurement will accept a monthly invoiced PO around $25k without an annual SOW? Or do they require a multi-month/annual commitment to onboard?
- Please share procurement contact (Ben Roy?) and preferred PO template.
- If you want, Karthik can run a 2-week dev trial with a 5M-token sandbox so you can validate latency/cost.

I’m copying Karthik for technical questions and Marissa for quick pricing flexibility if needed.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

[Attachment: Falcon_MVP_token_estimates.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Redwood_PRICING_2027.pdf (pdf)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@falconhealth.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Roy <ben.roy@falconhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Falcon Health follow-up — monthly spend band & procurement path

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from Procurement: 

- Our internal rule is we can issue monthly POs up to $25k without full vendor onboarding. Anything above that needs vendor onboarding (security questionnaire + PO + 30-day payment).
- We are targeting an initial three-month pilot before committing to annual spend; Pilots are fine if we can keep month-to-month billing and cancel with 30 days notice.

Can Karthik confirm whether the dev trial would require a PO at all (or if there’s a way to run against the hosted API on trial credits)? Also, is Redwood able to accept a standard Falcon PO template (I'll attach separately if you want).

-Ben (procurement) — assigning you to confirm the PO path and expected onboarding lead time.

-Alyssa

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@falconhealth.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Falcon Health follow-up — monthly spend band & procurement path

Hi Alyssa / Olga —

Quick notes from my side on the dev trial and pricing mechanics: 

- Dev trial: we can spin up a sandbox workspace with 5M trial tokens and a telemetry dashboard. No PO required — we can issue trial credits from our hosted environment. That should let you validate latency and per-request token use.

- Billing options:
  • Pay-as-you-go (no commit): billed monthly, standard $/1M rate applies.
  • 3-month pilot with soft commit: we can set a billing cap and provide usage alerts. If pilot monthly spend crosses $25k consistently, we recommend switching to a reserved pool for steady latency and better economics.
  • Annual reserved pool: best unit cost but requires commitment and procurement onboarding.

- Edge cases: If Falcon needs an exception to the $25k PO threshold for the pilot, we can discuss a signed MSA + short SOW to get your procurement comfortable — Marissa, any comment here?

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@falconhealth.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Falcon Health follow-up — monthly spend band & procurement path

Alyssa —

Looping in briefly — happy to help accelerate procurement if Falcon wants to keep the initial pilot above the $25k PO threshold. Two practical options: 

1) Short SOW (3 months) + MSA signature: procurement gets the contract artifacts they need, Falcon can do monthly invoicing under the SOW. This path typically takes ~7–14 business days for onboarding.

2) If you prefer to avoid onboarding for the pilot: we can provide hosted trial credits (no PO) and then convert to a monthly PO if you decide to scale. No discounted pricing guaranteed on the trial, but actual cost visibility will help your team size commits.

If Falcon is serious about the reserved path and annual commit, we can put together a draft commitment schedule that targets effective pricing in the $220–$260 / 1M tokens range (requires committed monthly minimums and a 12-month term). I can draft a short SOW and pricing worksheet once you confirm which route you prefer.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
